description: Upload a video to a connected YouTube channel (resumable upload in 8 MiB pieces, any size; a call works ~45 s and returns status 'uploading' + upload_id — call again with upload_id until status 'done'; also resumes after an abort). Source: a video library entry (library_slug + language de|en), a document (document_id) or an https URL. Privacy is ALWAYS private or unlisted; going public needs update_youtube_video {privacy:'public'} and a human approval. With a library source the YouTube link is stored on the library entry. Note: Google keeps uploads of an unverified API project private until it passed the YouTube API audit — the answer says which privacy YouTube actually set.

captions.description: library source: also upload its subtitles (default true)

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

library_slug.description: Slug of the video library entry to upload (with language)

privacy.description: default private. Public only via update_youtube_video with human approval.

thumbnail.description: library source: set its poster as thumbnail (default true; needs a verified channel)

thumbnail_url.description: https URL of a JPEG/PNG thumbnail (max 2 MB)

upload_id.description: continue an unfinished upload (large files are sent in 8 MiB pieces; each call works ~45 s)

name: upload_youtube_video
